text: My daily routine starts early in the morning. I usually wake up at seven o'clock, drink a glass of water, and have breakfast with my family. After that, I get ready and start work at nine. I work until five in the afternoon, and I always take a short break at lunchtime. In the evening, I go to the gym or run in the park for about an hour. After exercise, I cook dinner and relax by watching TV or reading a book. I go to bed before eleven because staying consistent helps me feel energetic and focused every day.
